title: Teatime
description: It’s time for Teatime again! We invite you to join us for a cuppy. As we experience shorter days and colder temperatures, sit back with scrumptious scones and other tasty treats and enjoy a few poems and short stories being read aloud. Feel free to bring your own poems or short stories in English to share with us. The event is free but donations are welcome. Please sign up by Oct. 10th (required); to do so please talk to the staff at the library, telephone the library or send an email to Bibliothek-amerika@kultur.karlsruhe.de telling us your name and the number of people in your party.
